about: The falsifier: a place's own lock judged each signed line against the window its key holds now, while the ledger judges it against the window that stood at the epoch it was signed. lane-D's window closed at 228, and at 232 it was re-signed to 268 with the old line withdrawn. A line lane-D signed at 230, while it was closed, stood in an own lock and was refused in the ledger.

cases.name: lane-D, windows 188..228 from 188 to 232 and 188..268 from 232, a line signed at 230 judged by the window it holds now
cases.ledger: REFUSE·authority lane-D signed at epoch 230, after its epoch closed at 228
